text: Every time intelligence function this chapter covers depends on one thing: a table with a row for every single day, no gaps. Here's how to build and mark one.

Right-click your date table in the Fields pane — Mark as date table, Mark as date table again. Power BI's automatic date/time detection is convenient, but marking your own table gives you control over fiscal years and custom hierarchies.
Pick the column that holds the actual date values. Validated successfully means it passed every check.
Four rules, checked every time: unique values, no nulls, contiguous dates with no gaps, and — if it's a Date/Time column — the same timestamp on every row. Fail any one, and Power BI tells you why.
With a real date table marked, every function in this chapter has something solid to stand on. Next: CALENDAR, for building one from scratch.
